name: reqif.export
title: Export ReqIF
summary: Export a selection or a saved export profile, or with statements the elements of the mapping's source, as ReqIF 1.2: IDENTIFIER `_` plus the UUID (the source IDENTIFIER for statements), text as XHTML and as `reqseq-markdown`, relations as SPEC-RELATIONs, targets outside the export as stubs.
whileReadOnlyReason: Exports the types and properties of the metamodel, which is missing or faulty.

profile.description: Name of a saved export profile of the mapping. Not taken yet: it gives `input.invalid`.

omitProperties.description: Added to the omitted properties of the mapping and the profile; with mapping, saved in it for later deliveries.

statements.description: Export the elements of the mapping's source with their statements, back to that source; needs `mapping`.

file.description: The written ReqIF file, relative to the workspace root when it lies inside, else absolute.

withoutStatement.description: With statements: exported elements without a statement.

items.description: Copied image or saved mapping file, relative to the workspace root.
